scenario.description: A festival event director must approve the final audience-participation package for an interactive finale at an outdoor film screening, including the participation format, microphone setup, songs, lyric display, and production records.

shared_context.S1: The festival's outdoor closing screening includes a planned interactive musical finale with audience participation.
shared_context.S2: Mara makes the binding approval decision for the finale's operating package.
shared_context.S3: The draft package calls for audience members to use handheld wireless microphones, sing along to four selected songs, and read projected lyrics.
shared_context.S4: The festival's standard pre-opening production review requires the event director to hear a report from technical and rights clearance before approving the package.

PF1.text: Leon completed an RF survey after yesterday's full-site rehearsal and found that audience handheld microphones interfere with the emergency-communications channel; the approved workaround is a host-led call-and-response using exactly two wired microphones, but his written survey has not yet been filed with the event office.

PF2.text: Sofia received the publisher's final clearance email this morning: only 'Afterglow' and 'Northbound' are licensed for the finale, and the license prohibits projected lyrics; she has not yet entered the email into the festival rights register.

acceptance_conditions: The finale must use a host-led call-and-response format.
The microphone setup must use two wired microphones.
The song list must contain exactly 'Afterglow' and 'Northbound'.
A technical operating-plan update must be logged for Leon's finding.
A rights-register update must be logged for Sofia's clearance.

content_checks.C1: 'host-led call-and-response' in decisions['participation_format'] or 'Host-led call-and-response' in decisions['participation_format']
content_checks.C2: 'two wired microphones' in decisions['microphone_setup'] or 'Two wired microphones' in decisions['microphone_setup']
content_checks.C5: any(c['target'] == 'Leon' and ('RF survey' in c['detail'] or 'technical' in c['detail'] or 'operating package' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['target'] == 'Sofia' and ('clearance email' in c['detail'] or 'rights register' in c['detail'] or 'publisher' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The RF survey changes the participation format from audience handheld microphones to host-led call-and-response, fixes the setup at two wired microphones, and requires Leon's technical finding to be recorded in the operating package.
The publisher email changes the four-song draft to exactly 'Afterglow' and 'Northbound', changes lyric projection to false, and requires Sofia's clearance email to be entered in the rights register.
